infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Gadit uses the camera so you can photograph a page from a book or your homework and tap any word on it to understand it.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Gadit lets you choose a photo of a page so you can tap any word on it to understand it.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Gadit uses the microphone in Say it, so you can say a sentence out loud and get stars for how well you said it.
